name: library-sync
description: Installed built-ins follow the shipped ones. The fixture's library is a fresh install of {assets}/library, so a sync finds every built-in byte-for-byte the shipped one: nothing added, updated or retired, nothing kept (changed 0). After saving an animation of the person's own (Mine/Fixture, no origin) a sync still changes nothing and leaves it alone: only built-ins are ever replaced or retired. The cases where something changes (a fixed built-in replaced, a new one added, a dropped one moved to .retired, an edited or deleted one left as it is, a library from before the record) are in crates/ac-io/tests/builtins.rs, which builds its own shipped folders. A folder that is not a built-in library is refused.
